annotations.title: Total what you pay for AI subscriptions

description: Use when the user lists the AI tools they pay for and asks what they spend per month or year, whether they are paying for overlapping tools, or what a stack of AI subscriptions costs. Returns the monthly, yearly and daily total, overlaps between plans, plans already included in another plan they pay for (could_cut, safe to drop), plans that merely overlap in kind (consider_dropping, ask before recommending a cut), and a link to a shareable receipt. Get plan keys from aitab_list_ai_plans. Example: {"plans": ["chatgpt.plus", "claude.pro", "cursor.pro"]}. Add ":y" to a key for yearly billing.

billing.description: Which total the shared receipt shows first. Default monthly.

plans.description: Plan keys, e.g. ["chatgpt.plus","claude.pro","cursor.pro"]. In a GET query use a comma-separated list.

name: aitab_total_ai_subscriptions
title: Total what you pay for AI subscriptions
